job.job_description:
We are seeking engineers with 3-4 years of software development experience, including 1 2 years specifically in building GenAI applications. If you've worked hands-on with LLMs, embeddings, RAG pipelines, and vector databases and you're excited about building products that leverage cutting-edge protocols like MCP this role is for you. Familiarity with vibe coding or similar prompt-oriented dev environments is a big plus.

Role Summary

As an AI Engineer at Yavar, you'll be at the heart of building high-performance, scalable GenAI applications. you'll work with LLMs (open and private), design fine-tuning pipelines, optimize vector search performance, and build secure agentic interfaces powe'red by emerging multi-agent coordination protocols (MCP).

Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and deploy LLM-powe'red features across Yavar s AI platforms.
Implement prompt engineering, fine-tuning, embedding generation, and vector-based retrieval strategies.
Build and manage RAG pipelines using public/private LLMs, vector DBs, and contextual memory.
Integrate multi-agent coordination using protocols like MCP (Multi-agent Communication Protocol).
Collaborate with product, infra, and UI teams to ship end-to-end AI features at scale.
Write clean, maintainable code using vibe coding frameworks or equivalent prompt-based dev setups.
Stay up to date with the latest in LLM optimization, open-weight models, and inference tuning.

Must-Have Qualifications:

3 4 years of experience in software development (Python, Node.js, or similar modern stacks).
1 2 years of hands-on experience in GenAI, LLMs, or NLP-based applications.
Strong understanding of fine-tuning strategies (LoRA, PEFT, full model).
Experience with embedding models, vector databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB, Weaviate, FAISS, or similar).
Solid grasp of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture and memory management.
Familiarity with multi-agent systems and emerging protocols like MCP.
Exposure to vibe coding, prompt-oriented frameworks, or LangChain-based development.
Experience in building APIs and microservices for AI workloads.
Bachelors or masters degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or equivalent.

Key Attributes:

Builder s mindset with deep curiosity for LLM behavior and tuning.
Pragmatic problem solver with clean coding habits.
Strong understanding of AI/ML pipelines and data flows.
Effective communicator who can explain model behavior and limitations.
Comfortable in fast-paced, iterative product environments.
Always learning and experimenting with new models and techniques.
